titleEn: Open the Shutters, Catch the Sunshine!

pages.text: "Lulu, let us pick olives!" Three cousins called together from the yard. Lulu pulled the blanket overhead. "Not yet! Warm under here. Only my ears are coming out."
Uncle Nino came up with his straw hat tipped back. "The sun is up! I used to get up first!" Lulu held the blanket tighter and stayed still.
Much later, Lulu woke. A line of sunshine through the shutter crack reached the foot of the blanket. The cousins were already in the field.
Uncle Nino sat on the bed edge, hat on his knees. "This woke me in my day. Stretch long." He held a forepaw toward Lulu.
Lulu stretched both forepaws above the head and both hind legs along the blanket. Lulu stretched longer than the blanket. Uncle Nino's straw hat tipped backward. "Sleep has slipped away!"
"After stretching, open the shutters wide," he whispered. Lulu stood and pushed with both hands. Creak! Slowly, the shutters opened.
The whole room brightened. Sunshine filled the floor. Lulu spread both arms. "Open the shutters, catch the sunshine!" The blue bell jingled.
Lulu stepped barefoot into the olive grove. The cousins waved beneath a tree. "Your basket is here, Lulu!"
Next morning, before the yard stirred, Lulu woke first. "One, wake and stretch! Two, shutters wide! Three, run to the hill! Open the shutters, catch the sunshine!"
Uncle Nino sat Lulu on his shoulders. Open shutters chase sleep away. "Faster than me! Open the shutters, catch the sunshine!"
